questions.question: In Jesus' story of the two sons, what did the younger son ask his father to give him?

answers.text: A field of his own to farm

questions.question: After the younger son ran out of money in a distant country, where did the man who hired him send him?

answers.text: Into his fields to feed the pigs
Into his vineyard to pick grapes
Into his house to serve meals

questions.question: In Jesus' story of the two sons, what did the father do when he saw his younger son coming home?

answers.text: Ran to him and embraced him
Waited for him at the front door
Sent a servant out to meet him
